description: Land Acquisition - Etanwala, Pitawala, Ilukkumbura D/S Division, Laggala Palllegama, Matale District - L/A - Assedduma, Kuliyapitiya West, Kurunegala District - L/A - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1978/31 of 04.08.2016 by Wattala D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Land Acquisition Act for acquiring specific land parcels for conservation purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land properties, extents, locations, claimants, and acquisition procedures, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
